lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular spots arranged in a geometric grid pattern posterior to the gill slits, with roughly four to five horizontal rows visible across the lateral midsection.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of slightly elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal carinae, with circular spot centroids located at these intersections, forming a regular matrix.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity transition from high-luminance upper edges to shaded lower troughs.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of smaller, irregular spots is visible on the dorsal surface of the head and the leading edge of the left pectoral fin.
